Stage 4 Final Results: RCDB-STGT

Final report of the completed A0–A9 experiments on the local MMASD OpenPose activity dataset.

Configuration note: A8 is not an independent ablation in the current code. A1 and A8 both set use_reliability_gate=False, and both edge learners receive joint reliability inputs. Their identical scores reflect the same configuration.

All runs use five cohort-grouped folds and seed 42. Cohort identifiers are not verified participant identifiers.

Scope and limitations

These results describe activity classification on this processed dataset and cohort-grouped protocol. They do not establish clinical effectiveness or generalization to verified unseen participants. A8 duplicates A1 and should not be counted as a separate confirmation.

Machine-readable results, out-of-fold predictions, robustness data, statistical outputs, and publication figures are retained in the Stage 4 project folders.
